paragraphs: I'm Tanvir, a student from Saidpur, Bangladesh. I'm drawn to anything that makes me ask how it works, from the code behind a website to the physics behind a rocket.

I'm exploring space, aerospace and science out of pure curiosity, and I look up at the night sky more than I probably should. I also enjoy photography, mostly of the sky, nature and quiet places. Technology and web development are part of what I like to explore too.
I'm still early in the journey. This site is where I keep what I'm learning.

_edit_guide.note: Edit only data.json to update your personal/profile/content information. The HTML is the design/engine.
_edit_guide.profile_image: Replace media/profile.jpg or change media.profile_image to another image path.
_edit_guide.music: Replace media/music.mp3 or change media.music to another audio path.
_edit_guide.photography: Change photography.items image paths to update the visual cards.
_edit_guide.planets: Edit or add planet facts in the planets list. Moon counts change as new moons are confirmed.
_edit_guide.resume: Set contact.resume to a file path like media/resume.pdf to show a Download CV button. Leave empty to hide it.
_edit_guide.projects: Each project can have name, description, status, tech and link. Link shows a View project button.
_edit_guide.sections: Profile, hero, About, Currently, Education, Skills, Projects, Photography, Movies, Books, Philosophy, Facts, Contact, Space Lab UI, AETHRYN UI, navigation, footer and media are all controlled here.
_edit_guide.labels: Change section/navigation labels in labels. Personal traits can be edited in about.chips.
_edit_guide.personal: Edit personal.personality, personal.values and personal.interests to update the Personal section.
_edit_guide.job: Update job.status, job.role, job.description and job.items in data.json without editing HTML.
_edit_guide.ui: Button/label text is in ui. Knowledge Corner questions are in knowledge. AETHRYN answers are in aethryn_ui.qa (keys = words to match, reply = answer). Hero bio is profile.bio, hero line above the name is profile.status.
_edit_guide.contact: Social icons (GitHub, Instagram, X, Facebook) come from contact.*. The Get connected block shows contact.email and contact.linkedin. Set contact.resume to show a Download CV button.
_edit_guide.aethryn_ai: General and Explore modes call aethryn_ui.api.url. Set aethryn_ui.api.enabled to false to turn them off. System prompts are in aethryn_ui.system.
_edit_guide.family: Family info is in family. It is used by Tanvir Mode (aethryn_ui.qa) and is NOT sent to the General/Explore AI. Set family.show to true to also show a Family section on the page.
